outputs.note: Full annual 2025 output verified from official archive across 6 published regular issues (89 unique research papers with valid DOIs). Reconciled with user's local catalog (vjmech_ojs_catalog.json, 88 records): the local catalog lacks issue groupings (catalog.issues is empty) and groups articles by online submission/posting date rather than published volume year. Consequently, the local catalog includes 16 unissued Online First articles (volume=None, issue=''), 6 of which were later assigned to 2026 issues and 10 remain unissued, while omitting 17 articles published in Vol. 63 (2025) whose online-first dates were in 2023 or 2024. All 89 articles in this dataset are verified directly from Vol. 63 No. 1-6 official issue pages.

Year-to-date 2026 output as of 2026-10-21 verified across 5 published regular issues (76 unique research papers with valid DOIs). Latest issue Vol. 64 No. 5 was published on 2026-10-20. Reconciled with user's local catalog (78 records): local catalog was exported prior to Vol. 64 No. 5 (which contains 15 articles, 12 new to local catalog) and includes 25 unissued Online First articles (volume=None, issue=''), while omitting 11 articles published in Vol. 64 whose online-first dates were in 2024 or 2025. Per contract, unassigned Online First articles are excluded until published in a numbered regular issue.
